Minimum salary  30,000

Explore the best-in-class travel and lifestyle privileges

    • 6 Miles on all other spends1

  • Earn 2.5 Etihad Tier Miles for every  10 spend on all spends3

  • Complimentary airport lounge access to over 1000 lounges worldwide via LoungeKey

  • Interest rate of 3.25% per month; minimum payment: 5% of the outstanding or  100, whichever is higher

1 Etihad Guest Miles earned on retail spends made on merchants located in European Union or under categories, grocery and supermarkets, quick service restaurant (i.e. fast food restaurant), insurance, car dealership, petroleum, transit, government services, utility payments, real estate, education & telecommunication payment will be capped at 1,500 Miles per statement cycle.

2 Maximum of 2 vouchers per annum upon reaching a spend of  150,000. The voucher issuance will be at an interval of 6 months starting from card issuance date. 

3 Maximum 50,000 Tier Miles can be earned per annum.

4 Maximum 4,000 bonus Etihad Guest Miles can be earned per statement cycle.

Marriott Bonvoy Points

  • Earn Marriott Bonvoy Points on spends
    • 6 points per US$1 spent at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy
    • 3 points per US$1 on international and all other spends

  • Domestic spends under the following categories earn points as follows:
    • Grocery and supermarkets, fast-food restaurants, insurance and car dealerships earn points at 25% of the domestic spend earning rate or 0.75 Points per USD
    • Petroleum, transit, government services, utility payments, real estate, education and telecommunication payments earn points at 10% of the domestic spend earning rate or 0.30 Points per USD
    • Spends originating in European Union countries earn points at 50% of the international spend earning rate or 1.5 Points per USD.
  • A chance to earn up to 50% more points every month on retail purchases if you enroll in the Express Points Programme* for a monthly fee of  300
  • Transfer points to over 40 airlines for flight bookings
